taxonomy.MEASURED: Observed by an executed command in a named local environment; limited to the property and context recorded.
taxonomy.SYNTHETIC: Produced from constructed fixtures or generated workloads rather than production traffic.
taxonomy.SIMULATED: Produced by a software model of a system or event rather than the physical system represented.
taxonomy.STATIC_DEMO: Rendered from maintained demonstration fixtures without live telemetry or control-plane authority.
taxonomy.UNCALIBRATED: Produced by a model lacking empirical calibration evidence for predictive-accuracy claims.
taxonomy.NOT_MEASURED: No responsible empirical measurement exists in the maintained repository evidence.

evidence.claim_boundary: Artifact inventory supports internal Phase 0-30 implementation coverage only.
A passing local regression establishes behavior for tested fixtures, not production performance.
These are repository architecture/completeness gates, not external certification.
Validation proves static fixture rendering and provenance boundaries, not live telemetry.
Scenario behavior is deterministic demonstration evidence, not observed infrastructure behavior.
Outputs are advisory simulation; predictive accuracy is not established.
No production infrastructure performance claim is supported by this baseline.
